intent: Appraise what scientific claims, study designs, and bodies of evidence can support under explicit validity and uncertainty judgments.
successCondition: The strongest supported conclusion is traceable to design, measurement, bias, confounding, statistics, causal assumptions, synthesis, and decisive unknowns.

direct: appraise whether this experiment supports its scientific claim
reconcile these studies into the strongest conclusion they jointly support
review this study design for bias confounding and statistical validity
paraphrased: separate genuine replication from conflicting or dependent evidence
stress test the methods before we collect data
tell me what this evidence really proves and where the inference overreaches
contextual: a causal conclusion may exceed the observational design
multiple studies disagree and their quality and comparability need explicit judgment
several outcomes and subgroup analyses may inflate the reported evidence
